messages:
Liam (AE): heads-up — Vela (enterprise fintech) wants a short POC next week. they sent a model we need to validate for our catalog and dedicated offer. customer is sensitive about latency and quantized memory footprint.
Maya (SE): can you drop the model name / basic metadata? will triage variant compatibility and estimate perf/cost.
Liam (AE): model: vela-phi-3b-v2 (community checkpoint). variants: float32, q4_0, q4_1. sequence target 8k, but their test set uses 2k average. licensing: permissive. they also asked if we can support on Dedicated w/ reserved capacity pricing.
Jordan (ML Eng): quick scan — config shows rotary embeddings + grouped-query attention flags. potential problem: our fused attention kernel currently assumes standard rotary layout for some model shapes; some checkpoints need small kernel tweaks.
Jordan (ML Eng): paste of the error they saw when attempting a local load: ```ERROR: failed to initialize fused_attention: unsupported layout 'gqa-rotary-v2' — falling back to generic aten attention (significant perf hit)```
Maya (SE): thanks. fallback is ok for functional tests, but will blow latency SLOs for streaming. options: 1) onboarding a tuned kernel for that layout (dev effort), 2) ask customer to use our verified variant (we can re-run quantization), 3) serve q4 variant but restrict max_seq_len and use prefix-KV caching.
Liam (AE): customer prefers not to change model weights. they asked if quantized q4_1 preserves accuracy enough. also asked about cost math for Dedicated vs Hosted for their expected 10 rps steady, bursts to 40.
Jordan (ML Eng): accuracy: q4_1 usually <1% eval delta on classification/eval sets for this family. for 2k avg seq and 10 rps: rough tokens/s: 2k * 10 = 20k tokens/s input+output ~ assume 1.5x -> 30k t/s. with Dedicated gpu pool (A100 80GB equiv) and batching we estimate sustained throughput ok but latency depends on whether fused kernel is used. fallback path increases per-token latency ~2-3x.
Maya (SE): I'll run a quick compatibility scan tomorrow: need model tarball, config, example prompts, and a small dev key to run on staging Dedicated. Liam — can you ask Vela for an encrypted transfer link + SAML contact for their engineer?
Liam (AE): will get that today. also flagged pricing Qs: are there standard discounts for reserved capacity on a 12-month commit?
Maya (SE): yes — reserved 12mo gives tiered discount; for 2x expected throughput we quoted 20% off list in the last deal. sales will formalize.
Priya (Security): quick sec checklist for POC: 1) data residency (do they require EU-only?), 2) model provenance & license (they said permissive, please attach), 3) will they send any customer PII in prompts? 4) retention settings for logs/inputs — default should be disabled for enterprise POC. please capture answers before we run.
Liam (AE): Vela response: EU residency required, they will not send PII in test set, license attached (MIT). ok to disable retention. they asked if our Private deployment (VPC) supports their SIEM ingest — they want syslog + S3 audit export.
Priya (Security): Private + VPC supports S3 audit export and webhook-based SIEM push. need SOC2 + pen test attestation — provide our latest report.
deploy-bot: new staging job queued: job_id=stg-7621, target=dedicated-staging, note="vela-phi compatibility scan"
Jordan (ML Eng): plan for triage: 1) run load with float32 to baseline perf; 2) run q4_1 on generic path to measure accuracy delta; 3) if generic path latency too high, prototype a small fused-kernel patch for the gqa-rotary layout and benchmark. estimate 3-5 dev days for the kernel work.
Maya (SE): agreed. deliverables for POC: - compatibility report (ops + perf) - recommended serving variant (and config snippet) - cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated w/ committed discount) - security artifacts pack.
Liam (AE): timeline: customer wants initial perf numbers in 5 business days. I'll sync with them on exact window and share SAML contact.
Priya (Security): I'll prep the security pack and redact any sensitive internal notes.
Maya (SE): action items: Jordan to start scan once model is uploaded; Priya prepping security pack; Liam to confirm transfer + timeline + reserved-pricing appetite. I'll schedule a short handoff call with Vela engineers after the first run. :calendar: :rocket:
Liam (AE): thx team — I'll update when transfer link is in.
Jordan (ML Eng): starting once file available — ping me with the link.
Maya (SE): closing thread for now, will reopen with the first compatibility report. :white_check_mark:
